nodes.text: The Vedharanyam farmer who committed suicide had participated in a protest in Chennai.

Farmers in Vedaranyam, Nagapattinam district of Tamil Nadu staged a unique protest by singing traditional oppari (lamentation) songs to press ... A row over the suicide of a farmer at a rally against a controversial land reform bill snowballed into a major controversy. A 60-year-old Chennai man died of suicide while allegedly supporting the farmers' protest going on at the borders of Delhi on Saturday.

claim: The Vedharanyam farmer who committed suicide had participated in a protest in Chennai.
